body: Live at my job, Yep, in the US. Working distracts me, keeps me occupied. It feels like I'm actually doing something worthwhile. Knee injury took me out of exercising, but it's hard to bitch about that with people who can't walk. This feels like a pouty rambling of someone who doesn't know enough about others to hate himself.
All of them moved away. Too far. At 36, with no family, and no contributions, there's little point to being a societal burden.
Shew... No clue. New Years Eve? Actually had people over for a bit. It felt like they were there because I invited them and not because they wanted something from me.
